name: test-automation-strategy
description: Test automation strategy — candidate selection (ROI-driven, stable-first, high-value flows), pyramid discipline (thick unit/component, thin E2E), framework + tooling per level, flakiness policy (quarantine + root-cause + budget), shared test fixtures + factories, page-object / component-object patterns, CI integration (sharding + parallelism + timeouts), regression strategy (full / nightly / impact-based), visual / accessibility automation, contract testing (Pact). Distinct from overall test strategy (see test-strategy-plan). Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
